name: Hide & Seek Fab! Chocolate Flavoured Choco Chip Sandwich Cookies
ingredients_raw: WHEAT FLOUR, SUGAR, HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE OIL, CHOCO CHIPS (SUGAR, HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE OIL, COCOA SOLIDS, EMULSIFIER [SOYA LECITHIN (E322)] AND ARTIFICIAL VANILLA FLAVOUR), COCOA SOLIDS, INVERT SYRUP, RAISING AGENTS (AMMONIUM BICARBONATE [E503(ii)], SODIUM BICARBONATE [E500(ii)]), ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURS (CHOCOLATE & VANILLA), SALT, CARAMEL COLOUR [E150d], AND EMULSIFIERS (SOYA LECITHIN [E322], DI-ACETYL TARTARIC ACID ESTERS OF MONO AND DI-GLYCERIDES [E472e]).
